finding: Two exploratory failures appeared to lose a 310 application-group value. The writer emitted it before group 2, but the test lookup ignored fields preceding the linetype name; this was a test-observation error, not established data loss.
change: The shared test lookup collects fields across a whole record and distinguishes top-level name groups from nested application groups. A scratch control tests pre-name binary data and another record; unchanged and edited complex linetype round trips now run in the installed-codec fast lane.

validation.systemBroad: Exploratory [dxf][roundtrip][filter] 97/131 cases pass; 34 fail, 50 assertions fail versus 95/131 and 52 before this correction. No normalized failure expression increased.

limits: The controls validate the selected application group, not arbitrary opaque group semantics or all linetype profiles.
Current-head hosted CI, native GUI and cross-platform system-codec qualification remain open.
